messages:
maria (AE): FYI — Nimbus Health wants a non-standard billing plan for the renewal. Deal summary: $1.2M ARR, 1yr term. They propose a phased prepay: 40% upfront, 30% at Q2 milestone, 30% at Q3 milestone, and then a final true-up invoice with Net60 on the last 10%/adjustment. They also asked for escrow on the upfront. Need deal desk + finance signoff.
jon (SalesOps): Can you paste the proposed invoice schedule? Also is there a PO / procurement requirement?
sara (RevOps): @maria we need to know revenue recognition constraints — if it's prepaid but split invoices, do we recognize monthly or upfront?
maria (AE): Procurement requires PO and prefers Net60 on the final true-up only. They will pay upfront chunk by wire once we confirm escrow arrangement. No PO for the first invoice until legal finishes SOW.
kevin (Finance): Net60 on any invoice is a collections risk for us. If upfront is wired, that's fine for cashflow, but we need the escrow wording clarified — is it a performance escrow or payment escrow? Also need GL codes and billing contact.
devin (Legal): Pause — escrow language matters for liability. We can accept an escrow for the upfront, but need to ensure the release conditions are milestone-based and that Redwood retains right to revert funds if abuse. Also need a standing indemnity clause for regulated data handling.
elaine (CS): Nimbus will require SOC2 + certain audit rights during the contract. Legal: can that be scoped into the SOW? This impacts the timelines for PO signing.
rachel (DealDesk): From deal desk perspective: exception request required for Net60 on the final invoice + installment schedule. Please provide: customer billing profile, reason for escrow, and proposed fallback (e.g., holdback amount or ACH mandate).
maria (AE): Quick copy of the proposed invoice plan:
```
Invoice A (at signing): 40% of ARR = $480,000 — escrow deposit, wired within 10 business days
Invoice B (Q2 milestone): 30% = $360,000 — invoiced on milestone completion, standard Net30
Invoice C (Q3 milestone): 20% = $240,000 — invoiced on milestone completion, standard Net30
Invoice D (true-up/adjustment): 10%/true-up = $120,000 — Net60 requested for this invoice
```
jon (SalesOps): A couple notes: 1) The split sums to 100% (good). 2) If Invoice A is held in escrow we need a release schedule and a custodian (EscrowCo). 3) For billing system, we'll create separate invoice numbers with linked SOW references.
sara (RevOps): We prefer Net30 across the board. If they insist Net60 on the true-up, propose: Net30 but extend to Net45 only if they provide an irrevocable PO and automated ACH for the first three invoices. That reduces credit exposure.
kevin (Finance): Acceptable mitigation: require ACH mandate + credit check + cap Net60 to a single invoice under $150k. Anything above needs credit insurance or prepayment. The final true-up here is $120k so it fits under the cap. But we need legal to confirm escrow doesn't convert to credit exposure.
devin (Legal): We can do the escrow with clear release triggers. We'll draft a short escrow addendum and a fallback clause that releases to Redwood if milestones aren't met within 30 days of target. Need Nimbus to sign.
rachel (DealDesk): Please fill out the exception form: 1) Business justification, 2) Finance mitigations (ACH/credit cap), 3) Legal confirmation on escrow language. Once that's attached, I can route to VP Sales for final sign-off. ETA 24-48h for review.
maria (AE): Adding items to the form now. Also flagged the timeline — customer expects billing plan confirmed before EOW to hit their internal procurement cadence.
elaine (CS): I'll share SOC2 evidence bundle with Nimbus now so legal can move faster.
kevin (Finance): If we get wiring for Invoice A + ACH mandate + escrow addendum, Finance is OK to allow Net60 on Invoice D (final true-up) for this account. Condition: monitor aging and require weekly check-ins from CS for usage anomalies.
rachel (DealDesk): Noted. We'll approve conditionally once the form is submitted + legal escrow draft + ACH or wire confirmation.
maria (AE): Submitted exception form and uploaded the proposed escrow addendum draft. Ping me if any changes needed — thanks all. :pray:
dealbot: Exception request 1923 created and assigned to rachel; SLA 48h.
